notes: Tags belong to your account: Settings → Tags lists them all, even unused ones, and lets you add, rename or delete a tag everywhere at once. Each account has its own tags, and they sync with your paired devices.
Tag a whole gallery from Edit gallery → Gallery tags.
New tag search: every chosen tag can be “must have”, “any of” or “must not have”, all in the same search. Tap a tag to switch. For example: must have #action, any of #funny or #romance, and not #sad.
